# Poly Haven CC0 assets

This directory contains 1K source textures and processed model derivatives from Poly Haven. Every listed asset is licensed CC0 and may be used, modified, and redistributed.

- Source library: <https://polyhaven.com/>
- License: <https://polyhaven.com/license>
- Asset manifest and intended uses: [`docs/art/AUTHORED_ENVIRONMENT_PIPELINE.md`](../../../../../../docs/art/AUTHORED_ENVIRONMENT_PIPELINE.md)
- Acquired: 2026-08-03

Included asset IDs:

- `rural_landscape`
- `red_laterite_soil_stones`
- `grass_path_2`
- `white_rough_plaster`
- `clay_roof_tiles_02`
- `wood_planks_dirt`
- `island_tree_02`
- `jacaranda_tree`
- `grass_bermuda_01`
- `calathea_orbifolia_01`
- `wooden_crate_01`
- `painted_wooden_bench`
- `wooden_ladder`

High-resolution downloaded model sources are excluded from the repository. The committed FBXs are game-ready derivatives built by `Tools/ArtPipeline/process_cc0_models.py`.
